description: Vantixs is a visual algorithmic trading platform for building, validating, and testing strategy pipelines. The ChatGPT app connects to the Vantixs MCP server so users can inspect node schemas, validate pipeline JSON, browse templates, review saved strategies, run backtests, and monitor portfolios from natural-language conversations. Trading-related actions are protected by OAuth and explicit confirmation flows.
